title: How a 22 year old built a million dollar app with AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: A 22-year-old just sold an AI app for $1 million — and you can too.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing the game for startups faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s an app that uses AI to generate custom workout plans in seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The AI learns from user data and adapts in real time — no coding needed.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Fitness coaches and gyms are using it to boost engagement by 70%.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is combining AI with a real-world problem that people care about.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how to build your own AI app? Follow for the next steps.
